experiments.evidence_boundary: P4 and numerical P1/P2/P3/P5 are complete with E3 persisted-evidence checks, so all five numerical T03 groups close only inside the frozen uncalibrated 2D teaching-model boundary. P2 comprises bottom-interface DIT, the bulk equation smoke and formal isolated NTA/NGA V3 sensitivity; V1/V2 failures remain preserved. P3 V1 remains E0/FAIL and its archive collision supplement remains visible; V2 closes only a symmetric lumped series-resistance proxy, not TLM, metal, barrier or injection physics. P5 completed one formal V_t-only run with 3 devices, 123 converged DC solves, 93 points, 3 states and 18 VTK; runner 14/14 E2 and independent 15/15 E3 passed, maximum terminal imbalance was 4.37301e-10 and 300 K exactly reproduced T02-C. Across 250/300/350 K, VTH and SS proxies increased, gm and high-gate current proxies decreased, and low-gate current proxy increased. These are numerical responses to changing only V_t while mobility remains 35.5 cm2/(V*s) and DOS, band parameters, permittivities, contacts, traps, geometry and bias stay fixed. They are not experimental or physical IGZO temperature dependence, activation energy, mobility/DOS/contact/trap temperature laws, physical SS/VTH/Ioff/Ion, operating range, self-heating, reliability, uncertainty, compact-model, circuit-cell, layout, PEX or HZO evidence. Only an M00 input contract may be established next; compact-model fitting or SPICE remains closed until that contract passes and is committed.

experiments.name: igzo_teaching_multicurve_surrogate_fit
experiments.purpose: Map qualified project teaching-model terminal curves to an IGZO-only compact surrogate with an untouched whole-condition holdout and explicit non-calibration boundary.
acceptance: training and holdout linear/log errors reported separately
multiple VDS curves included in training and holdout
parameter provenance and local validity domain complete
experiments.evidence_boundary: The original E3 contract freezes bytes, selectors, a 9-curve/163-point training set, a 4-curve/70-point whole-condition holdout, seven zero-VDS invariants, the teaching kernel, bounds, optimizer, metrics, outputs and failure rules. The single formal R01 run remains E0/FAIL because the L=12 um holdout gm relative error was 0.512384 versus the frozen 0.50 limit; its complete evidence remains preserved and its PASS-only independent checker did not run. The E3 R02 contract changes only model structure: because the committed training split has eight 10 um curves, one non-reference 8 um curve and two R01 free length coefficients, it fixes the analytic Lref/L geometry exponent at 1.0, removes length_exponent, retains one train-fitted length threshold coefficient and reduces the parameter count to 10. Dataset bytes, split, metrics, all thresholds and validity remain identical. No R01 holdout metric or fitted coefficient selected that structure or any R02 numerical setting. The fixed inverse-length factor is a regularizing teaching assumption, not a physical scaling-law claim. The single R02 formal run then passed 24/24 runner gates and its independent standard-library persisted-evidence check passed 20/20; all 12 runner artifacts, 247 selected/predicted rows, 13 curve metrics, 10 teaching coefficients, figures and unexecuted candidates are preserved. R02 closes M00 only within the frozen qualified teaching-model numerical boundary. Candidate files are generated-only; ngspice/AIM-Spice, TCAD, circuit and downstream remain unrun. Neither revision supplies experimental calibration, physical parameters, independent external validation, simulator validation, native HSPICE Level 61 execution or circuit evidence. The next gate is the M01 simulator cross-check contract.
